flow: rev6-p4-chain-live: deploy WorldProvenance on Ethereum Sepolia, then a shared world's beats recorded by a test-mode world service and compared at the door by main's reader
tree: snapshot of origin/main 12c29e7 (git archive), node_modules and .env symlinked, private Vite cacheDir .vite-cache and renderer port 5198 (strictPort) added to electron.vite.config.ts

chain.keySource: UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY from the repo .env, passed only as SERVICE_CHAIN_KEY to the deploy and service processes; never printed or written

model: none answering: the HUD showed "UNREACHABLE llamacpp · local" and "No model calls counted for this world yet."; no model call was made
sequence: SCR=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $SCR/snap $SCR/service $SCR/ud; git archive origin/main | tar -x -C $SCR/snap; ln -s $PWD/node_modules $SCR/snap/node_modules; ln -s $PWD/.env $SCR/snap/.env
$SCR/snap/electron.vite.config.ts, renderer section: cacheDir: resolve(__dirname, ".vite-cache"), server: { port: 5198, strictPort: true }

(cd $SCR/snap && UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 SERVICE_CHAIN_RPC_URL=https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com SERVICE_CHAIN_ID=11155111 SERVICE_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS=0xF625ec3c228e3BCE34977C0b7e97BD591291Ef02 SERVICE_CHAIN_KEY="$(grep '^UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY=' <repo>/.env | cut -d= -f2-)" bun run service -- --port 8796 --data $SCR/service) &

(cd $SCR/snap && env -u SERVICE_CHAIN_KEY -u SERVICE_CHAIN_ID -u SERVICE_CHAIN_RPC_URL -u SERVICE_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_URL= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_KEY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_ACCOUNTS= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_FROM_BLOCK= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_HOOK= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_PARENT= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_REGISTRY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_RELAY= UNWRITTEN_LINEAGE_ROUTER= UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY= UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_RPC_URL=https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS=0xF625ec3c228e3BCE34977C0b7e97BD591291Ef02 UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_CHAIN_ID=11155111 AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/ud bunx electron-vite dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9342) &

for k in 1 2 3: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8796/v1/test/advance -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"days":7}', then wait until the service log shows a new 'provenance: recorded' line (one record transaction per beat)

cp $SCR/ud/histories/<world>/log.jsonl $SCR/copy/real/; copy differs-check.ts.txt to $SCR/snap/scripts/prov-differs.ts; (cd $SCR/snap && UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_RPC_URL=… UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_ADDRESS=… UNMAPPED_PROVENANCE_CHAIN_ID=11155111 bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json scripts/prov-differs.ts $SCR/copy/real <world>)
kill -TERM $(lsof -tiTCP:8796 -sTCP:LISTEN); CDP Browser.close on ws://127.0.0.1:9342 (json/version webSocketDebuggerUrl); lsof on 8796, 9342, 5198 finds nothing
replayNote: A replay on a fresh machine skips the deploy (the CREATE2 address already holds the code) and opens a new stream for its own new world: one openStream plus one recordBeats per beat from the recorder key it is given.
